notes.title: Update notes for December 19
notes.notes:
-Added keybinding option.
-Added Mouse Y Invert option.
-Fixed Tow Truck stuck when towing.
-Added warning panel to Load option instead of loading directly in order to avoid losing progress when loading without saving.
-Fixed NPC trade money glitch.

notes.title: hotfix v05
notes.notes:
-Flashlight added to crafts.
-Changed some craft recipes.
-Fixed Item descriptions not showing.
-Fixed an issue with saves.

notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 14
notes.notes:
-Fixed Revolver damage.
-Fixed "Inventory full" prompt showing up wrongly.
-Respawn button now has a notification before respawning.
-New game button now has a notification before starting a new save.
-Improved "Old Sedan" handling.
-Changed vehicle fuel consumption.
-Fixed vehicle storages sharing same inventory.
-Changed collectable sticks to tree trunks.
-Minor performance improvements.
-Fixed player glitching through ground.
-Fixed player constantly running.
-Removed an unused area from Junkyard.
-Fixed main menu options.
-Fixed an issue that prevents saving settings.
-Changed background musics.
-Added NPCs that you can interact and trade items with.
-Minor visual improvements.
-Fixed "Woodcutting" and "Mining" tasks not gathering any items. (Now drops gathered items to "Wood Storage" and "Ore Storage")
-Added "Wood Storage" and "Ore Storage".
-Added Lights to "Tow Truck".
-Added missing Japanese translations.

notes.title: hotfix v04
notes.notes:
-Fixed vehicles spawning in wrong places.
-Fixed vehicles teleporting-disappearing.
-Fixed a bug that allowed item duplication.
(Performance optimizations and settings bug fixes coming up in the next update)

notes.title: hotfix v03
notes.notes:
-Fixed an issue with white screen showing on main menu.
-Fixed UI not fitting on some screen resolutions.
-Some quest rewards changed.
-Flashlight light intensity changed.
-Fixed some issues with farming.
-Fixed bugs related to saving-loading the game.

notes.title: Hotfix v02
notes.notes:
-Fixed game frozing when interacting with some objects.
-Fixed a bug with UI not closing when completing some quests.
-Changed Farming mechanic to be more usable.
-Fixed some localization issues.
-Added background music.
-Added background music volume to the settings.
-Changed cutting trees and breaking stones, now items directly goes into player inventory instead of dropping on the ground.
-Added Hungarian and Viatnemese language support.
-Improvements on UI/UX.
-Minor performance improvements. (There will be more performance updates in the near future)
